C.prompt: Read the letter from the school. Dear parents, The weather this week has been very hot, so please give your child a water bottle every day. Please do not give the money to the class teacher, Ms Laila. Send it to Mr Faris in the office by Tuesday. Children should wear their school T-shirt and comfortable shoes. If it rains, we will go to the Science Museum. Thank you, Mrs Amal, Head Teacher Question: What is the letter mostly about? (a) the hot weather (b) a class trip to the zoo (c) school T-shirts
